mounts.name: riding horse
text: {hero} buys a riding horse, and rides it up and down the high street twice to be seen on it.
{hero} has a horse now: no more walking to the edge of the map.

mounts.name: warhorse
text: {hero} calls a steed out of the light: a grey warhorse that comes when whistled for and is never there when it isn't wanted.
A warhorse answers {hero}'s prayer, its coat the colour of their oath.

mounts.name: griffon
text: {hero} buys a griffon from the Roost. The Roostmaster spends a week teaching them to stay on it; the griffon spends it deciding whether to let them.
{hero} rides a griffon now, and the river, the lakes and the mountains are no longer in the way.

over: There is no road across {name}, but they go straight over it, thanks to {carrier}.
Where everyone else goes round {name}, they cross it by {carrier}.
round: Nobody walks across {name}: they go round it, {days} out of their way.
{name} stands in the way and there is no crossing it on foot; the long way round costs them {days}.
ford: They cross {river} at {name}, wading to the waist.
